title: Ilhan Omar says she plans to move out of Washington home after federal raid
summary_full: Democratic lawmaker says family’s safety is at risk amid death threats and raid making apartment’s address publicOur reporters answer your questions about ICE, immigration and the midtermsMinnesota congresswoman Ilhan Omar said she plans to move out of her Washington DC apartment after federal agents raided her residence last week as part of a larger immigration investigation.“I mean obviously, I can’t continue to live there,” Omar told MS Now in an interview that aired on Wednesday. “So we have to figure out where to move to, because our address has been public and with the death threats that I deal with, it’s no longer going to be feasible to be in that house and have my kids, like, visiting off and on, having people track them.” Continue reading...
